about.metaTitle: About Us | ISI Building Solutions Cambodia
about.metaDesc: Discover ISI Building Solutions — Cambodia's pioneer in pre-engineered steel buildings with 300+ professionals, 1000+ landmark projects, and ISO 9001:2015 certification.
about.hero_subtitle: A member of ISI Group — one of Cambodia's most respected and diversified corporations with nearly 30 years of experience.
about.story_p1: ISI Building Solutions was established in 2012 with the mission to transform the construction of warehouse and factory from using conventional truss design to pre-engineered building.
about.story_p2: Starting with just four fresh graduate engineers, we have grown to over three hundred dedicated staff members. We have successfully completed over 1000 projects, including iconic structures such as the Aeon Mall Sen Sok Parking Structure and the International Exhibition Hall.
about.story_p3: In 2019, we obtained our ISO 9001:2015 accreditation, reinforcing our unwavering commitment to quality in every project we undertake.
about.vision_desc: Within 10-20 years, we envision leading the pre-engineered building industry, specializing in steel structures, and pioneering prefabrication that transforms regional construction.
about.vision_01_text: To transform the construction industry through prefabrication for safer working conditions and environmental sustainability. To be the Leader in Pre-engineered Building, Specialist in Steel Structure, and Pioneer in Prefabrication.
about.vision_02_text: We focus on designing and building faster, better, beautiful, and efficient structures. By applying Building Information Modeling (BIM), we streamline design, fabrication, and construction processes — our strategic intersection is "Prefab Design-Build."
about.m1_desc: Established with 4 fresh graduate engineers and a mission to transform conventional truss design to pre-engineered building.
about.m2_desc: Completed early industrial and commercial projects, establishing a reputation for quality and efficiency.
about.m3_desc: Achieved ISO 9001:2015 accreditation, reinforcing our commitment to quality management systems.
about.m4_desc: Grew from 4 engineers to over 300 dedicated staff, completing landmark projects like Aeon Mall Parking Structure.
about.m5_desc: Continuing to lead the pre-engineered building industry in Cambodia with over 1000 completed projects.
about.isiGroup_p1: ISI Group is one of Cambodia's most respected, successful, and diversified corporations with over 25 years of experience. The group operates across building materials, building solutions, property development, education, and food & beverage sectors.
about.isiGroup_p2: Our core values — Innovation, Striving, Integrity, Growing Together — guide everything we do as a group, with active CSR initiatives in education, environment, sports, and healthcare.

technology.metaDesc: ISI uses Tekla BIM, MBS, ETABS, and Microsoft Dynamics AX to deliver precision-engineered steel buildings with full digital integration from design to installation.
technology.hero_subtitle: Utilizing practical technologies to streamline design, fabrication, and construction processes, providing competitive advantage through innovation.
technology.approach_p1: We continuously seek suitable technologies and develop in-house solutions when necessary to maintain our competitive edge and deliver superior results for our clients.
technology.approach_p2: Our technology strategy focuses on full system integration across all business processes, from initial concept through final installation, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and quality at every step.
technology.bim_desc: We are implementing BIM technology throughout our entire business process—from project conception through design, modeling, procurement, manufacturing, quality assurance, to transportation and installation—to achieve full system integration.
technology.mfgSystems_desc: Developing integrated systems including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to optimize our production processes.
technology.tool_microsoftDynamics_desc: Manages finance and operations with comprehensive functionality for managing resources and processes connected to manufacturing, planning, supply chain, sales, financials and more.
technology.tool_teklaBim_desc: Creates structure models with accurate, reliable detailed information and generates automated shop and erection drawings for production.
technology.tool_mbs_desc: Provides design, detailing, costing, and drafting of metal buildings compliant with US and international codes, generating bills of materials and customized erection drawings.
technology.tool_scia_desc: Specialized software for analyzing and designing complex structures and challenging architectural projects with precision.
technology.tool_etabs_desc: Analyzes and designs buildings from low-rise to high-rise structures, including composite structures with advanced modeling capabilities.
technology.tool_cfs_desc: Specializes in cold-formed steel structural member design using American Iron and Steel Institute (AISI) standards.
technology.tool_framecad_desc: Designs light-gauge steel structures with automated drawings and production files for efficient manufacturing.
technology.impact_desc: By integrating advanced software solutions in our design and manufacturing processes, we ensure precision, efficiency, and environmental sustainability in every project we deliver.
technology.cta_subtitle: Discover how our technology stack delivers superior results across all our projects.

productsSolutions.metaDesc: Explore ISI's pre-engineered building systems and heavy steel structures — delivering cost-efficient, high-quality factory-manufactured buildings across Southeast Asia.
productsSolutions.hero_subtitle: Developing practical solutions that streamline steel structure design and build process, improving manufacturing productivity, and providing superior quality buildings.
productsSolutions.cta_subtitle: Let's discuss how our building systems can meet your specific requirements.
productsSolutions.peb_desc: ISI Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) is a complete system that incorporates new features of standing seam roofing solution, attractive wall cladding, standardized trim, and other accessories, providing excellent performance in terms of speed, cost effectiveness, long-term durability, functionality, appearance, and especially water leakage prevention. Ideal for both industrial and commercial applications such as warehouses, logistics facilities, and complex structures.
productsSolutions.peb_b4: Cost savings up to 30% vs conventional
productsSolutions.peb_b5: Wide clear spans up to 60+ meters
productsSolutions.heavy_desc: Specialized steel structural systems for vertical construction projects, including office buildings, shopping malls, showrooms, parking structures, and mixed-use developments. Engineered for strength, efficiency, and architectural flexibility. Our steel structures are fabricated into precise shapes and sizes according to the technical requirements of each project.
productsSolutions.heavy_b1: Launch business sooner with 30% faster construction
productsSolutions.heavy_b3: Reduce foundation costs with lightweight steel frames
productsSolutions.heavy_b4: Ensure perfect assembly using precision 3D design
productsSolutions.heavy_b5: Achieve modern looks impossible with traditional concrete
productsSolutions.truss_desc: ISI TRUSS offers a comprehensive range of roofing systems designed for durability, aesthetic appeal, and high performance in tropical climates. We cater to residential, commercial, warehouse, and heavy industrial applications, focusing on advanced coating technologies and structural integrity.
productsSolutions.truss_b2: Lower electricity bills with heat-reflecting advanced insulation
productsSolutions.truss_b3: Lock out water with 360-degree seaming technology.
productsSolutions.truss_b4: Extend building life with climate-resistant protective coatings.
productsSolutions.greenhouse_desc: ISI Greenhouse is designed as a high-quality, pre-engineered structural solution tailored for the modern agricultural landscape. It focuses on durability, climate control, and rapid assembly to support sustainable farming and commercial operations.
productsSolutions.greenhouse_b1: Control climate for consistent, year-round farming success
productsSolutions.greenhouse_b2: Maximize profits with durable and stable structures
productsSolutions.greenhouse_b3: Withstand high winds using UV-protected, rust-resistant steel
productsSolutions.greenhouse_b4: Expand easily with fast installation and relocation
productsSolutions.greenhouse_b5: Aesthetic design, built for multi-purpose creativity
productsSolutions.home_desc: ISI Homes offers innovative housing solutions that blend traditional Khmer aesthetics with modern engineering. Designed for safety, health, and affordability, we provide rural and suburban communities with high-quality homes built for lasting stability.
productsSolutions.home_b1: Integrated bathrooms and clean water for a healthy home.
productsSolutions.home_b2: Advanced insulation to maintain a cool, energy-efficient interior.
productsSolutions.home_b3: Strong steel frames built to last generations.
productsSolutions.home_b4: Quick on-site assembly without cutting quality.

buildingSystems.peb_desc: ISI Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) is a complete systems package that incorporates new features of standing seam roofing solution, attractive wall cladding, standardized trim, and other accessories, providing excellent performance in terms of speed, cost effectiveness, long-term durability, functionality, appearance, and especially water leakage prevention. Ideal for both industrial and commercial applications such as warehouses, logistics facilities, and complex structures.

designBuild.metaTitle: Architectural Steel Structures & Roofing Solutions | ISI Building Solutions
designBuild.metaDesc: ISI delivers architectural steel structures and roofing solutions through an integrated design-build approach that saves time, reduces costs, and ensures superior quality.
designBuild.hero_title: Architectural Steel Structures and Roofing Solutions
designBuild.hero_subtitle: Identifying projects with opportunities for implementing prefabricated construction methods that deliver innovation, efficiency, and value.
designBuild.why_p1: Design-Build saves time and money for the owner while providing the opportunity to achieve innovation because Design-build brings value engineering into the process.
designBuild.why_p2: Our methodology integrates architects, contractors, designers, engineers, and specialty trade contractors early in project development to propose cost-effective and constructable solutions.
designBuild.collab_desc: We partner with owners seeking integrated design-construction solutions that prioritize sustainable building methods and value engineering.
designBuild.ben_eco_desc: Manufacturing in controlled environments enables enhanced planning, waste reduction, and productivity improvements for sustainable building practices.
designBuild.ben_quality_desc: Factory-based assembly by experienced crews with multiple quality checkpoints produces superior results compared to site-built alternatives.
designBuild.ben_financial_desc: Modular, repetitive components enable mass production, making projects cost-competitive, particularly for large-scale developments.
designBuild.ben_fast_desc: Construction timelines can be reduced by over 50% through improved planning and elimination of weather-related delays.
designBuild.ben_safety_desc: Factory-controlled environments minimize moisture, environmental hazards, and dirt exposure during assembly processes.
designBuild.step1_desc: We identify projects with opportunities for implementing prefabricated construction methods that align with owner goals.
designBuild.step2_desc: Architects, contractors, designers, engineers, and specialty trade contractors collaborate early in development.
designBuild.step3_desc: Our integrated approach enables innovation and cost-effective, constructable solutions from the start.
designBuild.step4_desc: Components are manufactured in controlled factory environments with rigorous quality control processes.
designBuild.step5_desc: Pre-manufactured components are delivered and assembled on-site with precision and efficiency.
designBuild.step6_desc: Final quality checks, handover, and ongoing support ensure client satisfaction and project success.
designBuild.approach_desc: We target projects leveraging prefabrication, partnering with owners seeking integrated design-construction solutions that prioritize sustainable building methods.
designBuild.cta_subtitle: Let's explore how our integrated approach can bring value to your next steel structure project.
